description: The Kirloskar KDS-314++ is a heavy-duty monoblock centrifugal pump designed for agricultural irrigation, water supply, and industrial applications. Features dynamically balanced impeller and silicon carbide mechanical seal for extended life.
price_reasoning: Kirloskar authorized dealer in Pune ₹18,500 (MRP), IndustryBuying ₹17,800 (online discount), local pump dealer ₹16,900 (no warranty card). Chose authorized dealer price as it includes full warranty.
manufacturer_info: Kirloskar Brothers Ltd., established 1888, India's largest pump manufacturer with exports to 120+ countries. Headquarters in Pune, Maharashtra.
pros: SiC mechanical seal for long life
Energy efficient design saves power costs
Extensive service network in rural India
cons: Spare parts can take time in remote areas
